_comment: Copy to data/bike.json and fill in. brand/model are the HITS tripwire -- leave them empty and only the photo sweep runs. centre is the theft site: everything geo is measured from it, so put a real point in, and note that data/ is gitignored for exactly this reason. Reference photos go in data/reference-photos/ (3 is enough: drive side, rear, cockpit). See docs/RECOGNITION.md before touching any vlm_* key -- every threshold is calibrated against a probe table.
_comment_vlm: vlm.py is the recognition pass: Claude scores a swept photo 0-10 against the reference photos and only >= vlm_show_threshold reaches Telegram. A listing whose TITLE matches the brand/model is NEVER cut, at any score. Measured 2026-10-06: 119/120 real listings score <=2, the reference photos score 7-9 even repainted/stripped/dark/thumbnail-sized. vlm_pregate_* is the FREE CLIP filter in front of the paid call - 3 arms because there are 3 failure modes, and a REPAINTED bike survives on the kid arm ALONE while a STRIPPED one survives on navy/dropbar ALONE. Never collapse the arms or raise a threshold without re-running the 7-probe table in docs/RECOGNITION.md s2. Cost ~$0.0006/photo all-in after the pre-gate => ~$15/month, billed to the SAME Anthropic key the observer crons use, so it shows in the owner's top-ups. vlm_daily_budget_usd is a hard stop (falls back to the CLIP ranking and says so). vlm_enabled false turns the stage off. Haiku 4.5 was tested and is WORSE AND DEARER - it scored the loaded reference photos 2/10. Read docs/RECOGNITION.md before any change.
_comment_object: `object` picks profiles/<object>.json -- bicycle, motorbike or generic. `headline` and `description` are what the vision model is told to look for; leave them empty and a weak one is built from the fields above, which is enough to start and not enough to rely on. Read AGENTS.md section 3, then run ./calibrate.py.
